entries.en: We can divvy up the remaining sandwiches after the walk.
entries.zh: 散步后，我们可以分掉剩下的三明治。

entries.en: I will do the dishes while you dry the pans.

entries.meaningZh: 含有不雅意味的双关语

entries.zh: 喜剧演员那句带不雅意味的双关语让几位听众脸红了。

entries.en: The novel follows a draft dodger hiding under a false name.
entries.zh: 小说讲述了一名用假名躲藏的逃避服兵役者的经历。

entries.en: Put the washed cups on the draining board beside the sink.
entries.zh: 把洗好的杯子放在水槽旁的沥水板上。

entries.en: The architect tilted the drawing board towards the window.
entries.zh: 建筑师把绘图板朝窗户倾斜。

entries.en: A drawing pin held the timetable to the cork board.
entries.zh: 一枚图钉把时间表固定在软木板上。

entries.en: The guests arrived dressed to the nines for the anniversary dinner.
entries.zh: 宾客们盛装出席周年晚宴。

entries.en: He wrapped his dressing gown tightly around himself before opening the door.
entries.zh: 他开门前把睡袍裹紧了。

entries.en: A silver brush lay on the dressing table beneath the mirror.
entries.zh: 镜子下方的梳妆台上放着一把银色刷子。

entries.en: We refilled our bottles at the drinking fountain near the playground.
entries.zh: 我们在游乐场附近的公共饮水器处重新灌满了水瓶。

entries.en: My driving licence was still in the jacket I had left at home.
entries.zh: 我的驾驶执照还在那件落在家里的夹克中。

entries.en: They spent an hour practising their swings at the driving range.
entries.zh: 他们在高尔夫练球场花了一个小时练习挥杆。

entries.en: The drum majorette raised her baton as the parade began.
entries.zh: 游行开始时，鼓乐队女指挥举起了指挥棒。

entries.en: We shared the washing and drying up after the family lunch.
entries.zh: 家庭午餐后，我们分担了洗餐具和擦干餐具的活。

entries.en: A concrete barrier divides the traffic on this dual carriageway.
entries.zh: 这条双向车道上的混凝土隔离带分开了两个方向的车流。

entries.en: At the dude ranch, guests could ride horses along marked trails.
entries.zh: 在那座度假牧场，游客可以沿有标记的小径骑马。

entries.en: She fastened the toggles of her duffel coat before stepping outside.
entries.zh: 她出门前扣上了连帽粗呢外套的棒形纽扣。

entries.en: I packed an eating apple rather than a tart cooking variety.
entries.zh: 我装了一个适宜生吃的苹果，而不是酸的烹饪用苹果。

entries.en: The aviation exhibit displayed an ejector seat beside a cockpit model.
entries.zh: 航空展把一张弹射座椅放在驾驶舱模型旁展示。

entries.meaningZh: 说话行事使大人难堪的孩子
entries.en: The family's enfant terrible asked the guests how much money they earned.
entries.zh: 家里那个说话让大人难堪的孩子问客人赚多少钱。

entries.en: Training together helped the new recruits develop esprit de corps.
entries.zh: 共同训练帮助新兵培养了团队精神。

entries.en: The documentary includes testimony from families displaced by ethnic cleansing.
entries.zh: 纪录片收录了因种族清洗而流离失所的家庭的证言。

entries.en: The laboratory inventory listed ethyl alcohol among its solvents.
entries.zh: 实验室的清单把乙醇列在溶剂中。

entries.en: The recipe mixes evaporated milk with mashed potatoes.
entries.zh: 食谱将淡炼乳和土豆泥混合。

entries.en: The invitation specified evening dress for the formal reception.
entries.zh: 请柬要求出席正式招待会时穿晚礼服。

entries.en: The letter described the refund as an ex gratia payment.
entries.zh: 信中把退款称为出于通融而给予的款项。

entries.en: The dean is an ex officio member of the committee.
entries.zh: 院长依职权担任该委员会成员。

entries.en: The investigators tested the volunteers' claims of extrasensory perception.
entries.zh: 调查人员检验了志愿者们自称拥有超感官知觉的说法。

entries.en: The staff were presented with the office closure as a fait accompli.
entries.zh: 员工获知办公室关闭已经成为既成事实。

entries.en: The farmer planned to fatten up the cattle before winter.
entries.zh: 农场主打算在冬季前把牛养肥。

entries.en: Forgetting the host's name was an embarrassing faux pas.
entries.zh: 忘记主人的名字是一件令人尴尬的失礼之举。

entries.en: She split the pod and inspected each fava bean inside.
entries.zh: 她剥开豆荚，查看里面的每颗蚕豆。

entries.en: A purple feather boa completed the singer's stage costume.
entries.zh: 一条紫色羽毛长围巾为歌手的舞台服装作了点缀。

entries.en: We were fed up with hearing the same excuse every week.
entries.zh: 我们受够了每周都听同一个借口。

entries.en: A clean feeding bottle stood beside the folded baby blanket.
entries.zh: 一只干净的奶瓶放在叠好的婴儿毯旁。

entries.en: Their shared experience created a strong sense of fellow feeling.
entries.zh: 共同的经历使他们产生了强烈的共鸣。

entries.meaningZh: 危险而有诱惑力的女子
entries.en: In the film, the detective distrusts the mysterious femme fatale.
entries.zh: 在电影中，侦探不信任那位神秘而危险的美艳女子。

entries.en: The owner consulted a book on feng shui before rearranging the furniture.
entries.zh: 主人重新摆放家具前查阅了一本风水书。

entries.en: The medical atlas showed a fever blister on the upper lip.
entries.zh: 医学图谱展示了上唇上的一处唇疱疹。

entries.en: The tenancy records were locked in a metal filing cabinet.
entries.zh: 租赁记录锁在一个金属档案柜中。

entries.en: We stopped at a filling station on the outskirts of town.
entries.zh: 我们在镇郊的一座加油站停了下来。

entries.en: The runners accelerated as they approached the finishing line.
entries.zh: 跑步选手们接近终点线时加速了。

entries.en: The fire brigade arrived while smoke was still rising from the warehouse.
entries.zh: 仓库仍在冒烟时，消防队赶到了。

entries.en: The inspection report noted a missing fire extinguisher near the kitchen.
entries.zh: 检查报告指出厨房附近少了一个灭火器。

entries.en: The delivery van was parked well clear of the fire hydrant.
entries.zh: 送货车停在了离消防栓很远的地方。

entries.en: The historical drama shows a prisoner being led towards a firing squad.
entries.zh: 这部历史剧展示了一名囚犯被带向行刑队的情景。

entries.en: He balanced the fishing rod against the side of the boat.
entries.zh: 他把钓鱼竿靠在船舷上放稳。

entries.en: Our fishing tackle filled a small compartment beneath the boat seat.
entries.zh: 我们的钓具装满了船座下的一个小隔间。

entries.en: The fictional soldier escaped with a flesh wound to the arm.
entries.zh: 故事中的士兵逃脱了，手臂受了一处皮肉伤。

entries.meaningZh: 无固定政党倾向的选民
entries.en: As a floating voter, she compared the candidates rather than their party labels.
entries.zh: 作为没有固定政党倾向的选民，她比较的是候选人，而非他们的政党标签。

entries.en: The museum recovered a diary file from an old floppy disk.
entries.zh: 博物馆从一张旧软盘中恢复了一份日记文件。

entries.en: The only fly in the ointment was the hotel room's broken window.
entries.zh: 唯一美中不足的是酒店房间那扇坏掉的窗户。

entries.en: The children drew a flying saucer hovering above an imaginary city.
entries.zh: 孩子们画了一只悬停在想象中的城市上空的飞碟。

entries.en: We paid our former teacher a flying visit before catching the ferry.
entries.zh: 我们赶渡船前短暂地看望了以前的老师。

entries.en: The newspaper reported an investigation into suspected food poisoning at the event.
entries.zh: 报纸报道了对那次活动中疑似食物中毒事件的调查。

entries.meaningZh: 只要开口就可免费得到
entries.en: Spare cardboard boxes are available for the asking at the shop.
entries.zh: 在那家店，只要开口就能免费拿到多余的纸箱。

entries.meaningZh: 禁果；被禁止而诱人的事物
entries.en: To the curious children, the locked attic seemed like forbidden fruit.
entries.zh: 对好奇的孩子们来说，锁着的阁楼就像诱人的禁果。

entries.en: Forked lightning briefly lit the ridge beyond the valley.
entries.zh: 叉状闪电短暂地照亮了山谷那边的山脊。

entries.en: You can freshen up upstairs before we leave for dinner.
entries.zh: 我们出门吃晚餐前，你可以在楼上梳洗一番。

entries.en: She warmed the onions in a heavy frying pan.
entries.zh: 她在一口厚重的煎锅中加热洋葱。

entries.en: The family arranged a quiet gathering at the funeral parlour.
entries.zh: 家人在殡仪馆安排了一次安静的聚会。

entries.en: The anatomy model marked the gall bladder in green.
entries.zh: 解剖模型用绿色标出了胆囊。

entries.en: The garbage collector returned the empty bin to the pavement.
entries.zh: 垃圾收集工把空垃圾桶放回了人行道上。

entries.en: The costume department stored the garter belt with the vintage stockings.
entries.zh: 服装部门把吊袜腰带与复古长袜存放在一起。

entries.en: Their old gas guzzler cost too much to use for daily commuting.
entries.zh: 他们那辆老油老虎用于日常通勤花费太高了。

entries.en: The laboratory compared the samples using genetic fingerprinting.
entries.zh: 实验室采用遗传指纹分析来比较这些样本。

entries.en: I ordered ginger ale with ice and a slice of lemon.
entries.zh: 我点了加冰块和一片柠檬的姜味汽水。

entries.meaningZh: 传染性单核细胞增多症
entries.en: The archive contains a report on glandular fever among university students.
entries.zh: 档案中有一份关于大学生群体中传染性单核细胞增多症的报告。

entries.en: The school exhibition used temperature records to illustrate global warming.
entries.zh: 学校展览用温度记录来说明全球变暖。

entries.en: A globe artichoke grew beside the path in the vegetable garden.
entries.zh: 菜园小径旁长着一株朝鲜蓟。

entries.en: The band ended the evening with a golden oldie everyone could sing.
entries.zh: 乐队以一首人人会唱的怀旧金曲结束了当晚的演出。

entries.en: The gossip columnist waited outside the theatre for the film stars.
entries.zh: 那位名人八卦专栏作者在剧院外等候影星。

entries.meaningZh: 铁路与公路的平交道口

entries.zh: 火车驶近时，平交道口的栏杆落了下来。

entries.en: Measure the granulated sugar before adding it to the mixing bowl.
entries.zh: 把砂糖加入搅拌碗前，先量好用量。

entries.en: The campaign drew its strongest support from the grass roots.
entries.zh: 这场运动从基层民众中获得了最有力的支持。

entries.en: The ground crew checked the aircraft before passengers boarded.
entries.zh: 乘客登机前，地勤人员检查了飞机。

entries.en: The reception desk is on the ground floor beside the entrance.
entries.zh: 接待台在与地面齐平的一层，位于入口旁。

entries.en: The ground plan shows two staircases behind the entrance hall.
entries.zh: 底层平面图显示，门厅后有两座楼梯。

entries.en: The lease lists ground rent separately from the building's maintenance charges.
entries.zh: 租约把地租与建筑物的维护费分开列出。

entries.en: The parents discussed the child's growing pains with the doctor.
entries.zh: 家长与医生讨论了孩子的生长痛。

entries.en: The diary records rainfall throughout the growing season.
entries.zh: 日记记录了整个生长季节的降雨情况。

entries.en: The gardeners will grub up the old hedge before planting fruit trees.
entries.zh: 园丁们会在种果树前把旧树篱连根挖出。

entries.zh: 展览中有一个导弹的剖面模型。

entries.en: The guinea pig hid beneath a pile of clean hay.
entries.zh: 那只天竺鼠躲在一堆干净的干草下面。

entries.en: The legal history lecture examined a petition for habeas corpus.
entries.zh: 法律史讲座研究了一份人身保护令申请。

entries.en: The coach slowed before the hairpin bend above the village.
entries.zh: 长途客车在村子上方的发夹式急弯前减速了。

entries.en: The gallery devoted one room to twentieth-century haute couture.
entries.zh: 画廊专门用一个房间展示二十世纪的高级女式时装。

entries.zh: 她睡觉前把助听器放进盒子里。

entries.zh: 没人愿意解释延误原因时，他变得很恼火。

entries.en: The hollow tree made a good hiding place for the children.
entries.zh: 那棵空心树成了孩子们很好的躲藏处。

entries.en: We seemed to hit the jackpot when we found a buyer immediately.
entries.zh: 我们立刻找到了买家，仿佛意外中了大奖。

entries.en: My landlord will hit the roof when he sees the broken window.
entries.zh: 房东看到那扇破窗户时会勃然大怒。

entries.en: He paused to hitch up his trousers at the knees before sitting.
entries.zh: 坐下前，他停下来把膝部的裤管稍稍往上拉。

entries.en: The satire contrasts the privileged guests with the hoi polloi outside.
entries.zh: 这部讽刺作品将享有特权的宾客与外面的普通民众作了对比。

entries.en: A small mushroom tart was served as the hors d'oeuvre.
entries.zh: 一道小蘑菇挞被作为餐前开胃菜端上桌。

entries.en: His interest in horse racing began during a visit to the local track.
entries.zh: 一次参观当地赛马场的经历使他开始对赛马运动感兴趣。

entries.en: The holiday programme offered horseback riding along the beach.
entries.zh: 度假活动安排中有沿海滩骑马的项目。

entries.en: A new footbridge connects the housing estate with the station.
entries.zh: 一座新的人行桥把住宅区与车站连接起来。

entries.en: The map marked the forest as a former royal hunting ground.
entries.zh: 地图把那片森林标为昔日的皇家猎场。

entries.en: The loud music seemed to hype up the crowd before the match.
entries.zh: 比赛前，响亮的音乐似乎使人群兴奋了起来。

entries.en: The ice lolly melted before we reached the beach.
entries.zh: 我们还没到海滩，冰棍就化了。

entries.en: She dusted the cooled biscuits with icing sugar.
entries.zh: 她在冷却的饼干上撒了糖粉。

entries.en: The notice said the tenant was two months in arrears with the rent.
entries.zh: 通知说那名租户拖欠了两个月的租金。

entries.en: She mentioned the broken gate in passing during our conversation.
entries.zh: 她在谈话中顺便提到了那扇坏掉的门。

entries.en: The agreement preserves public access to the woodland in perpetuity.
entries.zh: 协议永久保留了公众进入那片林地的权利。

entries.en: The archaeologists photographed the vessel in situ before moving it.
entries.zh: 考古人员移动那只容器前，先在原位拍了照。

entries.en: A rumour of closure was in the air all week.
entries.zh: 关闭的传闻整整一周都在流传。

entries.en: The ticket included lunch and a guided tour in the bargain.
entries.zh: 票价包括午餐，另外还附带一次导览。

entries.meaningZh: 亲身出现的；本人在场的
entries.en: Seeing the singer in the flesh was different from watching her on television.
entries.zh: 见到歌手本人，与在电视上看她的感觉不同。

entries.en: The sudden shower did not bother the children in the least.
entries.zh: 突如其来的阵雨丝毫没有让孩子们烦恼。

entries.en: Cancelling at the last moment left the organisers in the lurch.
entries.zh: 最后一刻取消，使组织者陷入了困境。

entries.en: The reviewers were, in the main, pleased with the revised proposal.
entries.zh: 评审者大体上对修改后的提案感到满意。

entries.en: The painting shows the swimmers in the raw beside a lake.
entries.zh: 画中，湖边的游泳者赤身裸体。

entries.en: The researchers observed the cells in vitro under controlled conditions.
entries.zh: 研究人员在受控条件下于体外观察这些细胞。

entries.en: The investigation focused on suspected insider trading before the announcement.
entries.zh: 调查的重点是公告发布前疑似发生的内幕交易。

entries.en: The instant replay showed the ball crossing the line.
entries.zh: 即时重放显示球越过了线。

entries.en: The technician examined the integrated circuit through a microscope.
entries.zh: 技术员通过显微镜检查那块集成电路。

entries.en: The interior decorator suggested warmer colours for the waiting room.
entries.zh: 室内装饰设计师建议候诊室采用更温暖的色调。

entries.en: The folded ironing board fitted behind the kitchen door.
entries.zh: 折好的熨衣板能放在厨房门后。

entries.en: After a year in one city, she began to get itchy feet.
entries.zh: 在同一个城市住了一年后，她开始渴望出门旅行。

entries.en: Her laughter and curiosity filled the room with joie de vivre.
entries.zh: 她的笑声和好奇心使房间里充满了对生活的热爱。

entries.en: In the final chapter, the dishonest official receives his just deserts.
entries.zh: 在最后一章，那个不诚实的官员受到了应得的惩罚。

entries.en: A cup of tea in a quiet room was just the ticket after the noisy journey.
entries.zh: 喧闹的旅途过后，在安静的房间里喝杯茶正合需要。

entries.en: The report examines community programmes intended to reduce juvenile delinquency.
entries.zh: 报告研究了旨在减少少年违法犯罪的社区项目。

entries.en: The film follows a juvenile delinquent trying to return to school.
entries.zh: 电影讲述了一名试图重返学校的少年犯的经历。

entries.en: Talk to the caretaker if you want to know the score.
entries.zh: 想了解实情的话，就去和管理员谈谈。

entries.en: We need to knuckle down and finish the report before Friday.
entries.zh: 我们需要认真干起来，在周五前完成报告。

entries.en: The festival featured a demonstration of kung fu in the main square.
entries.zh: 节日期间，主广场上有一场中国功夫表演。

entries.en: The museum displayed a landing craft used to carry troops ashore.
entries.zh: 博物馆展示了一艘曾用于运送部队上岸的登陆艇。

entries.en: The model shows the aircraft with its landing gear extended.
entries.zh: 模型展示了飞机放下起落架的状态。

entries.en: Passengers waited on the landing stage as the ferry approached.
entries.zh: 渡船靠近时，乘客们在码头上等候。

entries.en: The small aircraft approached a grass landing strip beyond the farm.
entries.zh: 小飞机接近了农场那边的一条草地简易起降跑道。

entries.zh: 即将退休的指挥把那场音乐会称为自己的最后一次演出。

entries.en: In the historical novel, a priest arrives to perform the last rites.
entries.zh: 在那部历史小说中，一位神父前来主持临终仪式。

entries.en: Lateral thinking helped the team find an unexpected use for the empty warehouse.
entries.zh: 从不同角度思考，帮助团队为那座空仓库找到了出人意料的用途。

entries.en: The museum displayed an old apparatus once used to administer laughing gas.
entries.zh: 博物馆展示了一件曾用于施用笑气的旧装置。

entries.en: Floodlights illuminated the rocket on its launching pad.
entries.zh: 泛光灯照亮了发射台上的火箭。

entries.en: They try to lay aside a little money each month for repairs.
entries.zh: 他们每月尽量积蓄一点钱，用于修缮。

entries.en: The new rules lay down a clear procedure for handling complaints.
entries.zh: 新规定为处理投诉制定了明确的程序。

entries.en: I hope to lay eyes on the finished sculpture before the exhibition.
entries.zh: 我希望在展览前看到完成的雕塑。

entries.en: The lodge planned to lay in extra supplies before the winter storms.
entries.zh: 小屋计划在冬季风暴来临前额外储备一些物资。

entries.en: A bad bout of flu can lay up even the busiest worker.
entries.zh: 一场严重的流感也能让最忙碌的工作者卧床不起。

entries.zh: 工程师检查了机翼前缘是否有凹痕。

entries.zh: 她成了镇上业余剧团中有影响力的杰出人物。

entries.zh: 图表记录了每位学生在多次记忆测试中的学习曲线。

entries.en: The batter sent the ball deep into left field.
entries.zh: 击球手把球打向左外野的深处。

entries.en: She spread lemon curd between the two layers of sponge cake.
entries.zh: 她在两层海绵蛋糕之间抹上了柠檬酱。

entries.en: We paid a monthly fee to borrow novels from the lending library.
entries.zh: 我们按月付费，从收费外借图书馆借阅小说。

entries.en: Her liberal arts courses included history and philosophy.
entries.zh: 她的文科通识课程包括历史和哲学。

entries.en: The seminar explored the influence of liberation theology on community organising.
entries.zh: 研讨课探讨了解放神学对社区组织工作的影响。

entries.en: A lima bean plant climbed the wooden support beside the fence.
entries.zh: 一株利马豆沿着篱笆旁的木支架攀长。

entries.en: The dancers gathered backstage to limber up before the performance.
entries.zh: 舞者们聚集在后台，在演出前活动身体。

entries.en: Each copy of the limited edition bears the artist's signature.
entries.zh: 这套限量版的每一本都有艺术家的签名。

entries.en: A trading pidgin became the busy port's lingua franca.
entries.zh: 一种商贸混合语成了繁忙港口的通用语。

entries.en: In the sentence, the linking verb connects the subject with an adjective.
entries.zh: 在这个句子中，连系动词把主语与一个形容词连接起来。

entries.en: A few colourful cushions could liven up the plain sitting room.
entries.zh: 几个彩色靠垫就能让朴素的起居室变得有生气。

entries.meaningZh: 维持合理生活水平的工资
entries.en: The workers asked for a living wage rather than another temporary bonus.
entries.zh: 工人们要求的是足以维持合理生活水平的工资，而不是再发一次临时奖金。

entries.en: The solicitor kept a signed copy of the client's living will.
entries.zh: 律师保存了一份客户签署的生前医疗预嘱副本。

entries.en: He packed long johns for the winter camping trip.
entries.zh: 他为冬季露营旅行装好了长内衣裤。

entries.en: The old looking glass reflected a narrow strip of sunlight.
entries.zh: 那面旧镜子映出了一道细长的阳光。

entries.en: They thought restoring the flooded theatre was a lost cause.
entries.zh: 他们认为修复被洪水淹过的剧院注定不会成功。

entries.en: The study compares how the novel portrays the lower class and the aristocracy.
entries.zh: 这项研究比较了小说对社会下层和贵族的描写。

entries.en: The commentator dismissed the violent faction as the party's lunatic fringe.
entries.zh: 评论员把那个暴力派别斥为该党的狂热极端派。

entries.en: The anatomy chart showed a lymph node near the jaw.
entries.zh: 解剖图显示了下颌附近的一个淋巴结。

entries.en: A magnifying glass revealed tiny cracks in the painted surface.
entries.zh: 放大镜显出了漆面上的细小裂纹。

entries.en: The composer spent his final decade completing his magnum opus.
entries.zh: 那位作曲家花了生命最后十年的时间完成他的代表作。

entries.en: The shop added our address to its catalogue mailing list.
entries.zh: 商店把我们的地址加入了商品目录的邮寄名单。

entries.en: The old ledger recorded a shipment of malt whisky from Scotland.
entries.zh: 旧账簿记录了一批从苏格兰运来的麦芽威士忌。

entries.en: The grocer placed a tin of malted milk beside the cocoa.
entries.zh: 杂货商把一罐麦乳精放在可可粉旁。

entries.en: The managing director approved the budget for the new workshop.
entries.zh: 总经理批准了新车间的预算。

entries.en: We poured maple syrup over the warm pancakes.
entries.zh: 我们把枫糖浆淋在热煎饼上。

entries.en: The marching band turned into the square without missing a beat.
entries.zh: 行进乐队转入广场时，节拍丝毫没有乱。

entries.meaningZh: 市场力量；供需相互作用
entries.en: The report examined how market forces affected rents in the city.
entries.zh: 报告研究了市场力量如何影响这座城市的租金。

entries.en: We used masking tape to protect the window frame while painting.
entries.zh: 我们刷漆时用遮蔽胶带保护窗框。

entries.en: Applicants completed a means test before the committee considered financial assistance.
entries.zh: 委员会考虑给予经济援助前，申请人先接受了经济状况调查。

entries.en: The butcher dismantled the meat grinder for cleaning.
entries.zh: 肉贩把绞肉机拆开清洗。

entries.en: The old hall became a meeting place for neighbourhood discussions.
entries.zh: 旧礼堂成了邻里讨论的聚会地点。

entries.en: The students compared the melting point of wax with that of ice.
entries.zh: 学生们比较了蜡和冰的熔点。

entries.en: The laboratory diagram showed a melting pot holding the heated material.
entries.zh: 实验室示意图展示了盛着受热材料的熔化锅。

entries.en: The ethics class debated arguments about mercy killing without reaching agreement.
entries.zh: 伦理课讨论了有关安乐死的论点，但没有达成一致。
